entries.title: When a Social Link will not rank up
entries.summary: A rank is not automatic after every meeting.
steps: Carry a matching Arcana Persona before starting a hangout. Check whether the game says your bond will grow.
Use a non-ranking hangout, a day-off invitation or a shrine relationship fortune to gain missing affinity. These use daytime.
From November 11, buy a Dating Site Note at Club Escapade and use it on the dorm computer at night. Choose the link that needs affinity, then revisit it on an available day.

entries.title: Social stat thresholds
steps: These are cumulative hidden points, not the musical notes shown after activities. Track the rank shown in your game.

entries.title: Library study
steps: Visit the school library after class on a school day to study for free. Story closures and exams affect access.

entries.title: Shopping and material preparation
steps: Police-station sales are on Monday; pharmacy sales are on Saturday. Buy supplies before committing to the evening activity.
Use the Equipment reference to search a requested item or material. Persona heart items require leveling their owner; register the Persona before claiming a heart item if you plan to produce more.
Talk to Elizabeth periodically to collect Twilight Fragments from Social Link progress. Save some for fixed Tartarus chests and useful gear.

sections.title: Gardening
sections.description: Planting and harvesting do not use a time slot. Evening gardening with a companion is a separate dorm activity.

entries.title: Healthy Tomato Sprout
steps: Buy sprouts at Rafflesia, plant on the dorm roof, and return after 10 days to harvest.
Tending with companions uses an evening and adds their crop variants. Multiple companions can contribute to the same crop.
